assets.name: researcher-poses-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production animation sprite sheet, transparent background. Match the supplied approved Schoolhouse Rock-inspired concept art: SAME original characters, thick imperfect ink lines, flat mustard/teal/coral/purple cel colors, subtle vintage print texture only inside opaque artwork. No panel frames, no labels, no text, no ground, no drop shadows. Clearly separated equal grid cells, generous transparent margins in EVERY cell. All parts fully visible, no touching neighboring cells. This is an asset extraction/redrawing request for our animation, not another storyboard. EXACTLY eight full-body poses of the SAME fictional woman, in 4 columns by 2 rows. Keep her purple cardigan, teal flared pants, dark huge ponytail, round spectacles, long nose, huge brown loafers and ivory coffee mug with coral flower. Consistent body scale, head size and foot baseline across cells. Read order: (1) facing RIGHT giving instructions with one hand extended, no paper; (2) walking LEFT, left leg far forward and right arm carrying mug; (3) walking LEFT passing pose, legs close, head bobbing down; (4) walking LEFT opposite long stride, right leg forward; (5) walking LEFT second passing pose, heel raised, ponytail swinging; (6) standing facing RIGHT, holding mug, neutral interested expression; (7) facing RIGHT, stunned slack-jawed with bulging eyes, mug held at chest, FREE hand spread in shock; (8) facing RIGHT same stunned stance with cheeks puffed, mouth open for a spit-take, mug tilted, but DO NOT draw airborne coffee droplets. Real varied walk cels, not repetitions. Woman only, no robot or scenery.
